news.title: Iowa State's external funding supports research initiatives, innovation
news.summary_en: Iowa State University raised a total of $487.9 million in external funding for the fiscal year that ended June 30. That's an 11.2% drop from the previous year. Part of the decline reflects a drop in federal research support.

news.title: The long shadow of a short fuse
news.summary_en: Parent‑teen friction may seem fleeting, but new Iowa State research shows those tense adolescent moments can echo through a family for decades. A multigenerational study finds that harsh parenting in adolescence can weaken bonds not only between parents and adult children, but between grandparents and grandchildren as well.
